title: Ivo and the Current
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Quentin Joubert, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
